== Summary ==
Game text of four [[Players Committee]] virtual cards, each shown three times: cropped from the Players Committee's 745-pixel Holotable image, rebuilt by swccg-cardmaker with Akzidenz-Grotesk BQ Condensed, and rebuilt with [[Holotable Text]] Regular. Made on 3&nbsp;November 2026 for the comparison on [[Holotable Text]].

== Licensing ==
The card crops are from the Players Committee's card images, used here to document the typeface. The rebuilt text was made by the swccg-cardmaker contributors.
